summary: First e2e test of CodeGanak v0.1 MVP. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (auth, repo import, indexing, tree, file content, semantic search, SSE chat, chat history, docs generation, delete). Frontend: landing, login, dashboard, github import (queued->ready), repo detail with all 5 tabs (Overview, Files, Chat, Search, Docs) all functional. Streaming chat with citations works. File tree loads and displays content. Semantic search returns results and result click opens file.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='repo-status-badge' is NOT wired on dashboard repo cards - it only exists on RepositoryDetail page. Testing agents polling status via dashboard testid will find zero elements even though 'READY' text is visible on cards.

Meta+K keyboard shortcut did not open the command palette dialog in headless Chromium. May need Ctrl+K on non-Mac or handler is only bound to metaKey. Also visible 'Jump to... K' UI button suggests click still works.

issues: a11y console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' from Radix Dialog usage. Non-blocking but should wrap hidden titles with VisuallyHidden.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='repo-status-badge' to Dashboard repo card badges for polling in tests
(Optional) Wrap Radix DialogContent bodies with a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for a11y
(Optional) Bind command-palette shortcut to both metaKey and ctrlKey
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_stats returns raw symbol dicts including possibly {_id} - it uses projection {_id: 0} so safe.
Multiple test-run repos accumulate on demo user's dashboard (4 cards seen). Consider a cleanup script or admin route.
Chat SSE persists assistant message in finally block even on error - good. But 'citations' is captured only if event arrived before delta; if order changes citations may be [].
seed_data_creation: Created test users via /api/auth/register with test_<uuid>@codeganak.dev prefix; imported uvicorn-gunicorn-fastapi-docker repo (deleted at end of test class).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend flows all functional. Only minor test-id gap on Dashboard status badge and Meta+K shortcut. Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regression.
